lines: The app ships no composer/autoload.php, so the server registers its generic loader for lib/ and looks every class up in the file system.

A composer/composer.json with config.vendor-dir ".", config.optimize-autoloader true, a config.autoloader-suffix and autoload.psr-4 {"OCA\\InviteApp\\": "../lib/"} makes composer dump-autoload write composer/autoload.php with a class map; the code of the app does not change.

lines: 3 classes in lib/ whose name does not follow PSR-4 below OCA\InviteApp, the namespace the server derives from <namespace> of info.xml. The loader of the server does not find such a class.
lib/controller/BaseController.php:8 OCA\InviteApp\Controller\BaseController, by its path OCA\InviteApp\controller\BaseController
lib/controller/TokenController.php:12 OCA\InviteApp\Controller\TokenController, by its path OCA\InviteApp\controller\TokenController
lib/service/TokenService.php:9 OCA\InviteApp\Service\TokenService, by its path OCA\InviteApp\service\TokenService

1 inline script in templates/. The Content Security Policy of the server runs neither a <script> without a source or the nonce of the response nor an event handler attribute, so the browser does not run them. A script added with OCP\Util::addScript() or addInitScript() runs.

10 inline styles in templates/. The default Content Security Policy of the server allows inline style; a response whose policy disallows it drops them. A stylesheet added with OCP\Util::addStyle() holds in both cases.
lib/ reads the clock directly in 3 places. OCP\AppFramework\Utility\ITimeFactory, a PSR-20 ClockInterface, gives the same time and can be replaced in a test.

1 place states routes that are no constants, so this cannot read them: the server builds them at run time. The inventory lacks them, and what depends on the full list of routes is left out: route-unreferenced, ocs-unreferenced, frontend-url-without-route, controller-method-unrouted and the operations of openapi-drift that no route provides.
